title: GBRG Blast-Radius Proof Artifact
description: Extends SCOPE-D's ProofArtifact with blast-radius fields. Every GBRG MCP tool returns this object (never a bare float).
$comment: EXTENDS SCOPE-D ProofArtifact. Source: /Users/michaelheller/dev/SCOPE-D/config/schemas/proof-artifact.schema.json ($id https://socioprophet.org/schemas/scope-d-proof-artifact.schema.json). The `epistemicLevel` enum below is inherited VERBATIM from that source.

epistemicLevel.$comment: Inherited VERBATIM from SCOPE-D proof-artifact.schema.json. CRITICAL: 'synthetic' means synthetic/not-real DATA. It MUST NOT be redefined or overloaded to mean 'auto-generated code' — codegen/auto-generated cells are marked by the separate top-level `generated` boolean, NOT by this level.

dependents_count.description: Direct dependents = in-degree of the cell in the frozen index.

test_coverage_reach.description: True if at least one test reaches this cell (incoming TESTED_BY edge).

churn_frequency.description: Historical change frequency of the cell (unnormalised count/rate).

blast_radius.$comment: Numeric scale is a 0.0-1.0 FLOAT so it can feed SCOPE-D's computeRiskScore directly. See docs/ADR-001.

derivation.description: Human-readable explanation of WHY this artifact holds (which cells/edges/tests were considered).

declared_by.description: Producing agent identity, resolvable in the agent-registry.

generated.$comment: True if the underlying cell is machine-generated (codegen). Kept SEPARATE from epistemicLevel 'synthetic' on purpose — see the epistemicLevel $comment and docs/ADR-001.
